title: chaetopappa lyonii
intro: Chaetopappa lyonii, commonly known as Lyon's desert marigold, is a species of flowering plant in the family Asteraceae. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Chaetopappa lyonii include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiseptic properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The bioactive constituents of the plant include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
